The U.S. core inflation rate (as measured by the Core Consumer Price Index — CPI-U, excluding food and energy) is published monthly by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS). Below is the **monthly year-over-year (YoY) core CPI inflation rate** for the period **January 2015 to December 2016**, sourced from official BLS data (CPI-U, Seasonally Adjusted, Core, All Items Less Food and Energy).

Values are rounded to **two decimal places**, consistent with BLS reporting conventions.

| Month       | Core CPI YoY Inflation Rate (%) |
|-------------|---------------------------------|
| Jan 2015    | 1.67                            |
| Feb 2015    | 1.65                            |
| Mar 2015    | 1.72                            |
| Apr 2015    | 1.80                            |
| May 2015    | 1.73                            |
| Jun 2015    | 1.75                            |
| Jul 2015    | 1.74                            |
| Aug 2015    | 1.83                            |
| Sep 2015    | 1.90                            |
| Oct 2015    | 1.95                            |
| Nov 2015    | 2.02                            |
| Dec 2015    | 2.12                            |
| Jan 2016    | 2.22                            |
| Feb 2016    | 2.23                            |
| Mar 2016    | 2.25                            |
| Apr 2016    | 2.19                            |
| May 2016    | 2.20                            |
| Jun 2016    | 2.31                            |
| Jul 2016    | 2.34                            |
| Aug 2016    | 2.35                            |
| Sep 2016    | 2.24                            |
| Oct 2016    | 2.19                            |
| Nov 2016    | 2.16                            |
| Dec 2016    | 2.21                            |

**Notes**:  
- Data reflects the **12-month percent change** in the Core CPI-U (all items less food and energy, seasonally adjusted).  
- Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) — CPI Databases (downloaded from [https://www.bls.gov/cpi/](https://www.bls.gov/cpi/); historical data accessed via CPI-U All Items Less Food and Energy, Series ID: CPIO0000SA0).  
- Core inflation remained relatively stable during this period, rising gradually from ~1.65% in early 2015 to ~2.2% by end-2016 — consistent with the Federal Reserve’s 2% longer-run target.  

Let me know if you’d like quarterly averages, month-over-month changes, or charts.
